3.3.4 Sleep
Entering a sleep state is similar to the shutdown sequence 3.12 except that
EcuM_GoHalt resp. EcuM_GoPoll is called instead of EcuM_GoDown.
caption: 3.3.4 Sleep

targets.why: EcuM_GoHalt places MCU in sleep mode.
